original_test_intent: Verify that one approved PCIe link detects and reports a correctable Replay Timer Timeout, performs bounded replay and maintains endpoint service without escalation, retrain or reset.
original_method: Do not run from the label. Future procedure must select one mapped transmitter/receiver direction and controlled traffic, baseline replay/link/AER counters, apply one vendor-defined ACK/NAK suppression or equivalent timer stimulus, correlate the replay-timer-specific status and bounded retry, then verify link, device and workload health.
manual_activity: The PCIe owner defines the timer-expiry mechanism and safe traffic, maps transmitter/receiver and BDFs, supervises one stimulus and restores the link and endpoint.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA PCIe RAS injector/spec/version/checksum and supported firmware/OS
Endpoint/root-port/slot/BDF/link topology, transmitter/receiver direction and representative traffic
Exact replay-timer stimulus, timing and proof it does not instead create Replay Number Rollover or Completion Timeout
Expected Replay Timer Timeout-specific AER/root-report fields, replay counter delta and observation deadline
Maximum retries/latency, no retrain/link loss/severe AER/device reset and workload continuity limits
AER clear policy, independent recovery, aborts and restoration
safety_requirements: No execution until timer stimulus and Criteria are approved
Use isolated traffic and independent OOB/console on a recoverable test system
Baseline link state, replay counters, AER status/masks, traffic latency/errors and device health
One timer event once; abort on retry storm, traffic corruption/stall, retrain, link down, severe AER or device loss
Preserve the first timer/replay evidence before approved clear and return link/counters/workload to baseline
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only PCIe topology, replay/AER/link counters, logs, traffic and device health
Review future timer-stimulus semantics and evidence mapping
Do not suppress ACK/NAK, alter timers/masks, inject, clear, retrain/reset, recover, repeat or decide result
engineer_actions: Publish the Replay Timer Timeout procedure and Criteria
Approve link direction, traffic, timer stimulus and bounded replay oracle
Confirm service continuity and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Trigger one controlled replay-timer expiry on one mapped direction under bounded traffic and show the specific correctable status, bounded replay and uninterrupted endpoint service.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds timer mechanism, link direction, traffic, counter/timing and continuity gates absent from the label-only source.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing acknowledgement timing can amplify retries and disturb all traffic on the link before software can collect evidence.

project_override_considerations: The injection locus must expose replay behavior without modifying production link parameters. If an interposer is used, correlate its timeline with both endpoint and root-port evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved replay-timer injector/spec and mapped link/direction/traffic
Baseline replay/AER counters, link width/speed/state and device-workload latency/error rate
Exact one-shot timer-expiry transcript or interposer trace with synchronized timestamps
Fresh Replay Timer Timeout-specific status/root report and bounded replay delta at the intended link
No rollover substitution, completion timeout, retrain/link loss, severe AER, reset, device loss or workload corruption
Restored state, stable traffic and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Define Reliability row107 Wistron-System RAS-00827-V003 Replay Timer Timeout CE: provide the authoritative NVIDIA injector/spec/version/checksum, endpoint/root-port/slot/BDF and direction, traffic profile and exact timer/ACK-NAK stimulus/command, expected replay-timer AER/root report/counter delta/timing, bounded retries/latency with no rollover/completion-timeout/retrain/link-loss/device impact, clear policy, OOB recovery, aborts and restoration; require fresh review.

review_improvement: Defines the timer, direction, traffic and bounded replay behavior needed to distinguish this case from neighboring replay and transaction timeout variants.
independent_technical_reasoning: Replay Timer Timeout is a Data Link Layer reliability event caused by acknowledgement timing, not a transaction completion deadline. Evidence must bind timer expiry and replay count to a known direction while proving the link stayed operational. Without a stimulus definition and Criteria, generic AER output could belong to rollover or another correctable event.
